shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,520p' ../round-brief.md
printf '\\n--- git ---\\n'
git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- files ---\\n'
rg --files -g 'CHANGELOG*' -g 'chatOrchestrator*' -g 'spec.md' specs | head -80
printf '\\n--- source ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
printf '\\n--- spec ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
printf '\\n--- changelog ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' CHANGELOG.md
printf '\\n--- existing relevant tests ---\\n'
rg -n -C 4 'beforeSession|afterSession|onError' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,170p' ../round-brief.md
sed -n '171,340p' ../round-brief.md
printf '\\n--- acceptance test ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
printf '\\n--- package commands ---\\n'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"
printf '\\n--- test config ---\\n'
sed -n '1,200p' jest.config.* 2>/dev/null
printf '\\n--- lore executables ---\\n'
command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg -n 'lore-query-trace|tests_covering|baseSystemPrompt' .lore scripts package.json tsconfig*.json src -g '"'!node_modules'"' | head -120"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"baseSystemPrompt|interface PromptBuilderConfig|type PromptBuilderConfig|class PromptBuilder\" src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts src -g '*.ts' | head -100
sed -n '1,200p' src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts
printf '\\n--- unit test relevant full ---\\n'
sed -n '100,410p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
printf '\\n--- source history/status ---\\n'
git log --oneline -8
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format= -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p'
printf '\\n--- workflow checks ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' .github/workflows/ci.yml
printf '\\n--- anchor tools ---\\n'
rg --files scripts .lore | rg 'spec|anchor|link|changelog'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- full CI brief escaped line count ---'
wc -l ../round-brief.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- changelog hook mentions ---'
rg -n -i -C 2 'beforeSession|afterSession|onError|hook' CHANGELOG.md | head -160
printf '%s\\n' '--- traceability rules ---'
sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\\n' '--- changed commits details ---'
git show --format=fuller --stat 962a4fc
git show --format=fuller --stat 2f4d465
printf '%s\\n' '--- branch versus main ---'
git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD
git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD
printf '%s\\n' '--- available lore binaries ---'
for command_name in lore_get_ci_failures lore-query-trace lore_query_trace; do command -v \""'$command_name" || true; done
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- npm test selection support ---'
node scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs 2>&1 | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- current spec citations ---'
rg -n '\\[validated by:' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- relevant main spec ---'
git show origin/main:specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,180p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- current unlinked test titles ---'
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '185,395p'
printf '%s\\n' '--- spec link tool help ---'
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --help 2>&1 | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts
git commit -m "docs: describe beforeSession failure hooks"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git push origin HEAD
git status --short --branch'
